notes.title: 1.2.2 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

1.2.2 was just pushed to live. This has some minor fixes, but most importantly, with this update, your time in Survive, number of stages in Shatter and rounds in Sequence will be added to leaderboards. 
Unfortunately, your PB for Survive won't count, only your next run.

The reason we do it this way, is that there doesn't seem to be a good way to populate a leaderboard so we can test it out ourselves, so we need your help to play the games so we can get a bunch of names and times/scores for all game modes!

The leaderboard will feature both a friends only and an everyone, for all 3 game modes. This way you can see all, and you can choose to only compare yourself to your friends. 

Hopefully we'll gather enough data so we can continue to work on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
After reading a few reviews, we've come to realize that Shatter is a bit too difficult, so we made a few changes to it! We also fixed a few bugs.

[h1]Shatter:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Removed 2 rows from both the top and bottom
    [*]Removed 3 columns from both left and right side
    [*]Capping speed with 2 shuttles so you have more reaction time
    [*]Fixed a bug where completing Shatter stages didn't properly work
[/list]


[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Achievements will be awarded retroactively if you already got them (applies to all but Survive at the moment). However, if you get the in-game achievement, you should be awarded the steam achievement for ANY of the achievements, including Survive achievements.
[/list]


[h1]Coming changes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Remove blocks from the middle of Shatter, making the logo light up the color of the ball, just like Survive. 
[/list]


Hope you like the changes, and if you have any more feedback, hit us up in the discussion section!
